messages.text: 我会只替换指定文件中的 h1 标题文字，然后读取文件核对，不执行其他修改或命令操作。

已在指定 `src/App.tsx` 中将 h1 标题替换为 `WSL_APP_MODEL_b026b5a262064f4bb4618886392fe946`。

toolExecutions.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('/home/agent/workspace/.wsl-apps/958a7f2a-0474-450f-a938-3a006accedee/src/App.tsx')
before = p.read_bytes()
old = '从这里开始构建'.encode()
new = b'WSL_APP_MODEL_b026b5a262064f4bb4618886392fe946'
assert before.count(old) == 1, 'Expected exactly one target string'
after = before.replace(old, new, 1)
p.write_bytes(after)
verified = p.read_bytes()
assert verified == after
assert verified.replace(new, old, 1) == before
print(verified.decode())
print('Verified: exactly one string replacement; all other bytes unchanged.')
PY"
